title: My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked TV Anime Reveals 2 More Cast Members
content:
NBC Universal revealed two new cast members for the television anime of Otsuji 's My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked ( Ibitte Konai Gibo to Gishi ) manga on Monday. The new characters will appear in the anime's eighth episode on August 26.

Hiroki Nanami plays Sadame Mikuriya, the student council president.

Nao Tōyama plays Hachi Ura, the student council vice-president.

The anime stars:

• Hina Suzuki as Miya Nakamura

• Kujira as Teru Kōnokura

• Yū Serizawa as Marika Kōnokura

• Yuka Nukui as Arisa Kōnokura

• Anna Mugiho as Gungnir

• Miyari Nemoto as Yaeko Kōzō

• Yumi Uchiyama as Nago

• M.A.O as Mitsuya

• Hiroki Tōchi as Ueki

• Eiko Yamada as Yasu Nakamura

• Yō Taichi as Riru Kazan

• Momoka Terasawa as Koyuki Inari

Keisuke Inoue ( My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! , Ao-chan Can't Study! , Level 1 Demon Lord and One Room Hero ) is directing the anime at NEWON . Nanami Hoshino ( Hokkaido Gals Are Super Adorable! , Mission: Yozakura Family episode scripts) is in charge of series scripts, and Mutsumi Sasaki ( Chaos;HEAd , Laid-Back Camp , Phantom ~Requiem for the Phantom~ ) is designing the characters and is also the chief animation director.

Lia performs the opening theme song "Amayadori no Shōkei" (Longing to Take Shelter From the Rain), and AVAM performs the ending theme song "Claire."

Seven Seas publishes the manga in English and describes the story:

Fairy tale tropes are turned on their heads in this award-winning and comedic reimagining of the classic Cinderella story! Miya is the illegitimate child of a prominent family. When her mother dies and her father's estate agrees to take her in, she's convinced she knows what awaits her in her new home: a life of servitude and misery at the hands of her wicked stepmother and stepsisters. Yet when she finally meets the women she expects to treat her like dirt, they actually end up being...sweet?! A hilarious and heartfelt comedy that's sure to put a smile on your face!

The manga launched on Ichijinsha 's Comic POOL digital manga magazine in November 2020. Ichijinsha will publish the manga's 10th compiled book volume on August 25. Seven Seas published the eighth volume in English on June 23.

title: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc Reveals 4th Trailer, Key Visual, NYCC Appearance with Mariya Ise
content:
The staff for Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc ( Tokyo Revengers: Santen Sensō-hen ), the latest arc of the Tokyo Revengers anime, revealed on Monday its fourth trailer and a new key visual. The staff also announced that Mariya Ise will attend New York Comic Con , which is taking place from October 8-11, to promote the arc.

go!go!vanillas will perform the ending theme titled "TRICK STAR."

The arc will get advance screening events on September 6 at TOHO Cinemas Roppongi Hills in Tokyo, and on September 21 at TOHO CINEMAS Namba in Osaka.

Pony Canyon describes the new arc's story:

The conflict between Tokyo Manji Gang and Tenjiku came to a gruesome end. As each individual carries their sorrow and moves forward on their own path,Takemichi Hanagaki(TAKE‐MITCHY) finds himself in awe of the late Tetta Kisaki. Upon hearing the full truth behind the time leaps, Manjiro Sano (Mikey) makes a crucial decision. After leaving the past behind, Takemichi finally reaches the ultimate future where his beloved Hinata is alive. However, "he" is nowhere to be found. In the era of the “Three Titans,” where three teams battle for dominance, the final revenge begins!

New cast members for the anime include:

• Mariya Ise as Senju Kawaragi

• Naoyuki Shimozuru as Takeomi Akashi

• Shinnosuke Tachibana as Wakasa Imaushi

• Takanori Hoshino as Keizo Arashi

• Hiroki Yasumoto as South Terano

Maki Kodaira ( The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse ) is directing the anime at LIDEN FILMS , replacing Kōichi Hatsumi from previous anime seasons. Hatsumi is now credited with collaborating on overseeing the series scripts. Airi Tsuyuki and Kae Takakura join previous character designers Keiko Ōta and Kenichi Ōnuki . (Tsuyuki and Takakura were animation directors previously in the anime.) Yoshitomo Hara joins Hideki Fukushima as bike and prop designer. Hiroshi Yataka , who worked on photography for previous seasons, is the new compositing director of photography, replacing Hisayoshi Yamamoto from the previous season. LIDEN FILMS is credited for 3D CG work.

Returning staff members include Yasuyuki Mutō in charge of series scripts, Rumi Matsumoto as art director, Kunio Tsujita as color key artist, Satoki Iida as sound director, and Hiroaki Tsutsumi as music composer.

Boy band JO1 will perform the new arc's opening theme song "IGNITE."

Ken Wakui launched the manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in March 2017, and ended the series in November 2022. Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English.

The manga's first television anime adaptation premiered in April 2021. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan. The anime's Tokyo Revengers: Christmas Showdown arc premiered in January 2023 and aired for 13 episodes. Disney+ and Hulu streamed the arc as it aired.

Tokyo Revengers: Tenjiku Arc ( Tokyo Revengers : Tenjiku-hen), the third season , premiered in Japan in October 2023. Disney+ exclusively streamed the anime worldwide (except in Mainland China).

The franchise has also inspired three live-action films.
author: ANN

title: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc (Season 4) New Trailer and Key Visual Revealed
content:
Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc (Season 4) sequel anime revealed a new trailer and key visual ahead of its October 2 premiere date. The anime previously revealed the voice cast for the founding members of Black Dragon , as well as South Terano. The anime will stream exclusively on Disney+ worldwide.

The anime was announced in July 2024 with a teaser visual featuring Takemichi Inagaki and Manjiro Sano (Mikey). It will continue after the Tenjiku Arc . A teaser visual was shown at AnimeJapan in March. Maki Kodaira is taking over as director from Koichi Hatsumi, who directed the first three seasons.

The trailer also features the previously announced opening theme “IGNITE” by JO1. The ending theme for the arc is “TRICK STAR” by go!go!vanillas. You can watch the new trailer below.

The staff for the new Tokyo Revengers anime includes:

• Director: Maki Kodaira

• Series Composition: Yasuyuki Muto

• Character Design: Kenichi Ohnuki / Keiko Ota / Airi Tsuyuki / Kae Takakura

• Bike & Prop Design: Hideki Fukushima / Yoshitomo Hara

• Art Director: Rumi Matsumoto

• Art Settings: Yuho Taniuchi

• Color Design: Kunio Tsujita

• Director of Photography: 家高浩司

• Sound Director: Satoki Iida

• Music: Hiroaki Tsutsumi

• Animation Production: LIDENFILMS

You can also see the full cast for the anime:

• Yuki Shin as Takemichi Hanagaki

• Azumi Waki as Hinata Tachibana (Hina)

• Ryota Osaka as Naoto Tachibana

• Yuu Hayashi as Manjiro Sano (Mikey)

• Masaya Fukunishi as Ken Ryuguji (Draken)

• Sho Karino as Chifuyu Matsuno

• Yoshitsugu Matsuoka as Takashi Mitsuya

• Tasuku Hatanaka as Hakkai Shiba

• Masaaki Mizunaka as Keisuke Baji

• Yukihiro Nozuyama as Ryohei Hayashi (Peh-yan)

• Kengo Kawanishi as Nahoya Kawata (Smiley)

• Daisuke Ono as Yasuhiro Muto (Mucho)

• Takuma Terashima as Atsushi Sendo (Akkun)

• Yuya Hirose as Takuya Yamamoto

• Shunsuke Takeuchi as Makoto Suzuki

• Shota Hayama as Kazushi Yamagishi

• Yumi Uchiyama as Emma Sano

• Showtaro Morikubo as Tetta Kisaki

• Takuya Eguchi as Shuji Hanma

• Junya Enoki as Seishu Inui

• Natsuki Hanae as Kokonoi Hajime

• Tomokazu Sugita as Taiju Shiba

• Nobunaga Shimazaki as Izana Kurokawa

• Seiichiro Yamashita as Kakucho

• Tetsu Inada as Kanji Mochizuki

• Koki Uchiyama as Shion Madarame

• Daisuke Namikawa as Ran Haitani

• Hiro Shimono as Rindo Haitani

About Tokyo Revengers

The first season of the anime aired from April 11 to September 19, 2021. Most of the cast reprised their roles in the second season, which premiered in January 2023 and had Masaya Fukunishi replacing Tatsuhisa Suzuki (the first season was also edited to reflect the changes). The third season , covering the Tenjiku Arc , premiered in October 2023 and is available worldwide exclusively on Disney+ (excluding mainland China).

The Tokyo Revengers anime is based on the manga by Ken Wakui. The manga was serialized in the Weekly Shonen Magazine from March 2017 to November 2022, officially ending on November 16 that year. Kodansha is publishing it in English, and they describe the story: Watching the news, Takemichi Hanagaki learns that his girlfriend from way back in middle school, Hinata Tachibana, has died. The only girlfriend he ever had was just killed by a villainous group known as the Tokyo Manji Gang. He lives in a crappy apartment with thin walls, and his six-years-younger boss treats him like an idiot. Plus, he’s a complete and total virgin … At the height of his rock-bottom life, he suddenly time-leaps twelve years back to his middle school days!! To save Hinata, and change the life he spent running away, hopeless part-timer Takemichi must aim for the top of Kanto’s most sinister delinquent gang!!
author: Anime Corner

title: New Rokudenashi Blues Manga Delayed to Winter, Gets New Artist
content:
This year's 18th issue of Shueisha 's Grand Jump magazine announced on August 19 that the launch of the upcoming Rokudenashi Blues Gaiden: Onikazura manga based on Masanori Morita 's Rokudenashi Blues manga is delayed from summer to winter and will now feature art by Yuki Yoshimoto .

Morita originally stated on X/Twitter in January that the manga is set in the first half of the 1990s, and is not a sequel, but is instead a story about "the fight between those two people" that took place during the manga but was never depicted. The manga will center on the characters Onizuka and Kasai, two of the "four heavenly kings" in the story.

Boichi was originally announced as the artist for the new series.

The original manga ran in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from 1988 to 1997 and has 42 volumes.

The manga inspired a 1992 anime film, as well as the Rokudenashi Blues 1993 anime film.

The manga inspired two live-action films in 1996 and 1998, as well as live-action television series that debuted in 2011. A stage play adaptation ran in December 2010.

The manga centers on Taison Maeda, a student at Teiken High School in Kichijōji, Tokyo, who aims to become a professional boxer, and who overcomes many formidable opponents.

Morita's other manga include Rookies , Beshari Gurashi , and Zashisu , among others.

Yoshimoto and Jun'ichi Fujisaku launched the Ghost in the Shell: The Human Algorithm manga in Kodansha 's Young Magazine in September 2019, and ended the series on the Comic Days app in April 2025.
author: ANN

title: Umayuru Full Gate! Umamusume’s Next ONA Premieres in September
content:
Umayuru Full Gate! will be the next Umamusume: Pretty Derby anime. The short-form (three-minute) ONA will debut on the franchise’s YouTube channel this September. Cygames has released a visual for the upcoming anime and listed AtoriE as the studio. However, the company did not provide any information on the show’s production cast. The premiere will include subtitles in English, Korean, and Traditional Chinese. The franchise’s VAs will reprise their roles.

Scooter Films animated the original 24-episode Umayuru ONA, as well as the follow-up, 4-episode Umayuru: Pretty Gray ONA. AtoriE is a relatively new studio. They’ll adapt the upcoming I’m Dating a Dark Summoner and Ghost Meets Gal! s hort-form anime.

Unlike the franchise’s previous anime, Umamusume: Cinderella Gray, Umayuru Full Gate! will take a more playful approach to the franchise’s stories.

Cygames, Inc. announced the Umamusume: Pretty Derby mobilegame in 2016. However, the game missed its 2018 Japanese release date and was instead released in February 2021. Cygames later released the game globally in June 2025. Since then, Umamusume: Pretty Derby has become one of the company’s most profitable titles. The mobile game has since been adapted into several manga, light novels, anime, OVAs, ONAs, and a theatrical film.

Both the game and the franchise have been so well received that they’re credited with starting a global resurgence in the popularity of horse racing.

Umayuru Full Gate! focuses on anthropomorphized versions of real-world racehorses who aim to compete and win the prestigious Twinkle Series.

title: Taejun Pak Launches New Inked Comic
content:
Webtoon artist Taejun Pak and his company The Grimm Entertainment have launched a new horizontal-scrolling comic in Japanese titled Inked on Kakao's Piccoma platform on August 16. The work is Pak's first horizontal-scrolling work. The comic is also mostly in black and white, instead of vertical-scrolling webtoon series that are usually in full color. Pak stated about the work, "it has been a long road to fulfill my dream of becoming a manga creator."

The comic's story begins ( Note: Story terms and name romanizations are not official ) when slave boy Rok is attacked by a group of monsters known as Tattoos. To survive, Rok brands himself with the Mark, the source of the Tattoos' power, and becomes a powered being known as a Marker. Now he plans to strike at the tyrannical family at the center of the Clof Empire, and its ruler Yujin.

Founded by webtoon artist Taejun Pak , The Grimm Entertainment owns several popular IPs, including Manager Kim , (also known as Agent Kim: Reactivated ) and Lookism , which have gained popularity in both South Korea and international markets. Pak and The Grimm Entertainment are also known for the Viral Hit webtoon, which has inspired both an anime and a Japanese live-action adaptation.

Kakao Games announced on August 4 that it has agreed to work with The Grimm Entertainment to develop and publish games based on its popular comic and webtoon intellectual properties.

title: Red River Anime Casts Sōma Saitō, Shun Horie
content:
The official website for the television anime of Chie Shinohara 's Red River ( Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori ) shōjo manga announced two new cast members for the anime on Monday. The new cast members include:

Sōma Saitō as User Ramses, a free-spirited Egyptian general, and Kail's greatest rival

Shun Horie as Juda Haspasrupi, the sixth prince in line for the Hittite throne, who has long looked up to Kail, and is suspicious of his mother Nakia

The anime premiered in NTV 's "AnichU" programming block on July 7 at 25:35 (effectively, July 8 at 1:35 a.m.), and on BS NTV on July 8. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as it airs in Japan.

The cast includes:

Kōsuke Kobayashi ( Waccha PriMagi! , Alice or Alice ) is directing the anime at Tatsunoko Production . Yoriko Tomita ( The Elusive Samurai , My Dress-Up Darling ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Kenji Fujisaki ( YU-NO: A girl who chants love at the bound of this world. , Blood Lad ) is designing the characters. Yoshihisa Hirano is composing the music, while Hiroto Morishita is the sound director. Team Kawadon is credited for sound production. Hiroki Nanami is performing the anime's opening theme song "Akatsuki no Sora" (Dawn Sky).

Historical researchers include Kimiyoshi Matsumura and Daisuke Yoshida , who are members of the Japanese Institute of Anatolian Archaeology as part of the Middle Eastern Culture Center in Japan.

Viz Media describes the manga's first volume:

title: 'Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori' Announces Additional Cast Pair, Second Cour for Fall 2026
content:
The official website of the Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori ( Red River ) television anime revealed two additional cast members on Monday. The anime series adapting Chie Shinohara 's adventure fantasy manga is currently airing with a second cour scheduled to begin on September 29 at 1:35 a.m. on NTV's AnichU programming block, followed by BS-NTV.

Voice actors Souma Saitou ( Shuumatsu no Walküre ) and Shun Horie ( Yuusha-kei ni Shosu ) are joining the cast as User Ramses and Juda Haspaslupi, respectively.

Kousuke Kobayashi ( Hyakuren no Haou to Seiyaku no Valkyria ) is helming the anime at Tatsunoko Production . Yoriko Tomita ( Nige Jouzu no Wakagimi ) is handling the series composition and Kenji Fujisaki ( Blood Lad ) is designing the characters. Yoshihisa Hirano ( Hunter x Hunter (2011) ) is composing the music.

Shinohara serialized the manga in Sho-Comi from January 1995 to January 2002. Shogakukan published the 28th and final volume in July 2002. The manga has a cumulative 20 million copies of its volumes in circulation, including digital editions.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English in February 2004 and published all 28 volumes from June 2004 to January 2010.

title: '100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You' Season 3 Casts Rie Kugimiya
content:
The official website for third television anime season based on Rikito Nakamura and Yukiko Nozawa 's The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You ( Kimi no koto ga Dai Dai Dai Dai Daisuki na 100-nin no Kanojo ) manga announced on Monday that Rie Kugimiya has joined the anime's cast as Yaku Yakuzen, Kusuri's grandmother and Rentarō's newest girlfriend. The character debuted in the third season's eighth episode on Sunday.

Seven Seas Entertainment is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the story:

Aijo Rentaro tried and tried again, but after asking a hundred girls out on a date, he was rejected every single time. In desperation, he prays for guidance...only to be told by a god that his rejections were due to some cosmic error! Now the god is going to set things right by making sure that Aijo gets one hundred dates. Except, as things often do with gods, the dates come with a catch: one hundred girls are destined to be Aijo's soulmate, and unless he returns their feelings each and every time, they'll die in horrible accidents! Sure enough, girls start confessing their love to Aijo left and right. But how is he supposed to choose?! He doesn't want to kill anyone! When he looks at each potential soulmate, it feels like a bolt of lightning. Can someone really love a hundred other people? This hilarious romantic comedy takes the harem concept to a wild extreme!

The new season also stars Kaori Ishihara as Chiyo Iin, Ayana Taketatsu as Nadi, Hana Tamegai as Yamame Yasashiki, and Aoi Koga as Momiji Momi.

Hikaru Sato ( Dropkick on My Devil! ) is returning from directing the first two seasons at Bibury Animation Studio . Takashi Aoshima ( Uzaki-chan Wants to Hang Out! ) is back in charge of the series scripts. Akane Yano ( Bottom-tier Character Tomozaki ) continues to design the characters. Shūhei Mutsuki , Shunsuke Takizawa (Trytonelabo), and eba are also returning to compose the music at Lantis .

The Rentaro Family perform the opening "Daisuki ♡Zutto Eien ni ♡" (I Love You ♡Always and Forever ♡).

The season premiered on the Tokyo MX channel on July 5 at 10:30 p.m. (9:30 a.m. EDT), and it will also run on Sun TV and BS11 .

title: One Piece May Have Just Confirmed the Elbaph Arc Is Ending Very Soon
content:
The One Piece manga continues its development despite having more breaks recently than ever. The manga is currently featuring an epic battle with Imu, the King of the World, who intends to bring Elbaph to its knees and is currently engaged in a battle against the warriors of Elbaph, with Luffy also joining the fight. However, Imu consistently overwhelms everyone, and recent chapters have also seen Imu nearly defeat Luffy. Had it not been for Gaban’s intervention, Luffy would have met his defeat and possibly died as well. However, it seems that Gaban might be the one who will actually die protecting Elbaph and Luffy.

However, the latest chapter, 1191, seems to have refrained from that possibility and is instead setting up the arc to end soon in a situation similar to what fans have already seen in the series. As Hajrudinn also joins the fight in the latest chapter, Gaban instructs Luffy to take his crew and get out of Elbaph. Even Hajrudinn gets overwhelmed, prompting Gaban to make it a priority for Luffy and his crew to leave the island, as he doesn’t see anyone getting out of this fight alive. Gaban’s insistence that Luffy and the Straw Hats leave the island could mean that the Elbaph arc will end with the Straw Hats leaving soon , as the warriors sacrifice themselves for Luffy to reach his potential and face Imu in the final battle of One Piece .

One Piece Might Enter a Time Skip as the Elbaph Arc Nears Its End

The recent chapters have made it very clear that despite Luffy’s overpowered Gear 5 transformation, he is still no match for the King of the World , the supposed final villain of the series. Luffy has to emerge as strong as Joyboy, and as Imu states, Luffy is nowhere near that level. This means that the captain of the Straw Hats will still need a lot more time before he can become as strong as Joyboy and actually challenge Imu. Therefore, Scopper Gaban’s insistence on Luffy and the Straw Hats leaving the island might become the priority, with Loki, Hajrudin, and Gaban paving the way.

This might become even clearer after seeing the outcome of Zoro and Sanji’s fights against their current opponents, Sommers and Killingham. Gaban has only now laid out the instructions for how they can actually land hits on these seemingly invincible villains, and with Sanji not even having Conqueror’s Haki, it seems impossible for them to actually defeat these villains without precise execution. All of this hints that, at their current capabilities, the Straw Hats are not strong enough to take on these new villains and will require training to emerge stronger.

This could indeed lead to the Straw Hats prioritizing leaving Elbaph and then training these new techniques, which could be featured in a time skip as well, given that it isn’t something the Straw Hats could master overnight. This would make perfect sense as a way for the Straw Hats to receive the boost they need to emerge stronger, and nothing could justify it more than a time skip, which could feature Imu gaining even more power in the meantime and ultimately propelling the final One Piece battle foretold by the Harley prophecy, with Luffy emerging as the true Joyboy with the Haki that Imu fears. In any case, One Piece is heading into its final stage, and since Elbaph isn’t the arc to feature the final battle, it means that this arc will subdue this conflict soon after the final villain showcases his power, giving the heroes the final boost they need to emerge stronger for the final war of One Piece .
